Curve

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve

StartUpTimeCurve

Type: object

Startup time curve as a function of down time, where time is specified in minutes. Relationship between unit startup time (Y1-axis) vs. unit elapsed down time (X-axis).

 No Additional Properties

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve Curve.CurveDatas

CurveDataArray

Type: array

Array of CurveData objects

 No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData

CurveData

Type: object

Multi-purpose data points for defining a curve. The use of this generic class is discouraged if a more specific class can be used to specify the X and Y axis values along with their specific data types.

 No Additional Properties

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData CurveData.xvalue

xvalue

Type: number

The data value of the X-axis variable, depending on the X-axis units.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData CurveData.y1value

y1value

Type: number

The data value of the first Y-axis variable, depending on the Y-axis units.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData CurveData.y2value

y2value

Type: number

The data value of the second Y-axis variable (if present), depending on the Y-axis units.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData CurveData.y3value

y3value

Type: number

The data value of the third Y-axis variable (if present), depending on the Y-axis units.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
root oneOf Curve oneOf StartRampCurve

StartRampCurve

Type: object

Rate in gross active power per minute (Y-axis) at which a unit can be loaded versus the number of hours (X-axis) the unit was off line.

 No Additional Properties

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartRampCurve IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartRampCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartRampCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root oneOf Curve oneOf StartRampCurve IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
root oneOf Curve oneOf ShutdownCurve

ShutdownCurve

Type: object

Relationship between the rate in gross active power/minute (Y-axis) at which a unit should be shutdown and its present gross MW output (X-axis).

 No Additional Properties

root oneOf Curve oneOf ShutdownCurve IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root oneOf Curve oneOf ShutdownCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root oneOf Curve oneOf ShutdownCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root oneOf Curve oneOf ShutdownCurve IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
root oneOf Curve oneOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve

ReactiveCapabilityCurve

Type: object

Reactive power rating envelope versus the synchronous machine's active power, in both the generating and motoring modes. For each active power value there is a corresponding high and low reactive power limit value. Typically there will be a separate curve for each coolant condition, such as hydrogen pressure. The Y1 axis values represent reactive minimum and the Y2 axis values represent reactive maximum.

 No Additional Properties

root oneOf Curve oneOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root oneOf Curve oneOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root oneOf Curve oneOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root oneOf Curve oneOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
root oneOf Curve oneOf HeatRateCurve

HeatRateCurve

Type: object

Relationship between unit heat rate per active power (Y-axis) and unit output (X-axis). The heat input is from all fuels.

 No Additional Properties

root oneOf Curve oneOf HeatRateCurve IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root oneOf Curve oneOf HeatRateCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root oneOf Curve oneOf HeatRateCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root oneOf Curve oneOf HeatRateCurve IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
root oneOf Curve oneOf EmissionCurve

EmissionCurve

Type: object

Relationship between the unit's emission rate in units of mass per hour (Y-axis) and output active power (X-axis) for a given type of emission. This curve applies when only one type of fuel is being burned.

 No Additional Properties

root oneOf Curve oneOf EmissionCurve Curve.CurveDatas

CurveDataArray

Type: array

Array of CurveData objects

Same definition as Curve.CurveDatas

root oneOf Curve oneOf EmissionCurve Curve.curveStyle

curveStyle

Type: enum (of string)

The style or shape of the curve.

Must be one of:

  • "straightLineYValues"
  • "constantYValue"

root oneOf Curve oneOf EmissionCurve EmissionCurve.isNetGrossP

isNetGrossP

Type: boolean

Flag is set to true when output is expressed in net active power.

root oneOf Curve oneOf EmissionCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

cimObjectType

Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

root oneOf Curve oneOf EmissionCurve EmissionCurve.emissionType

emissionType

Type: enum (of string)

The type of emission, which also gives the production rate measurement unit. The y1AxisUnits of the curve contains the unit of measure (e.g. kg) and the emissionType is the type of emission (e.g. sulfur dioxide).

Must be one of:

  • "carbonDisulfide"
  • "chlorine"
  • "sulfurDioxide"
  • "carbonDioxide"
  • "hydrogenSulfide"
  • "nitrogenOxide"

root oneOf Curve oneOf VsCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root oneOf Curve oneOf VsCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root oneOf Curve oneOf VsCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root oneOf Curve oneOf VsCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpCostCurve

StartUpCostCurve

Type: object

Startup costs and time as a function of down time. Relationship between unit startup cost (Y1-axis) vs. unit elapsed down time (X-axis).

 No Additional Properties

The style or shape of the curve.

Must be one of:

  • "straightLineYValues"
  • "constantYValue"

Valid values are Fast/Slow

  • "FAST"

root oneOf Curve oneOf RampRateCurve IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root oneOf Curve oneOf RampRateCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root oneOf Curve oneOf RampRateCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root oneOf Curve oneOf RampRateCurve IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
root oneOf Curve oneOf StartUpTimeCurve

StartUpTimeCurve

Type: object

Startup time curve as a function of down time, where time is specified in minutes. Relationship between unit startup time (Y1-axis) vs. unit elapsed down time (X-axis).

Same definition as StartUpTimeCurve

root oneOf StartUpTimeCurve

StartUpTimeCurve

Type: object

Startup time curve as a function of down time, where time is specified in minutes. Relationship between unit startup time (Y1-axis) vs. unit elapsed down time (X-axis).

Same definition as StartUpTimeCurve
root oneOf StartRampCurve

StartRampCurve

Type: object

Rate in gross active power per minute (Y-axis) at which a unit can be loaded versus the number of hours (X-axis) the unit was off line.

Same definition as StartRampCurve
root oneOf ShutdownCurve

ShutdownCurve

Type: object

Relationship between the rate in gross active power/minute (Y-axis) at which a unit should be shutdown and its present gross MW output (X-axis).

Same definition as ShutdownCurve
root oneOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve

ReactiveCapabilityCurve

Type: object

Reactive power rating envelope versus the synchronous machine's active power, in both the generating and motoring modes. For each active power value there is a corresponding high and low reactive power limit value. Typically there will be a separate curve for each coolant condition, such as hydrogen pressure. The Y1 axis values represent reactive minimum and the Y2 axis values represent reactive maximum.

Same definition as ReactiveCapabilityCurve
root oneOf HeatRateCurve

HeatRateCurve

Type: object

Relationship between unit heat rate per active power (Y-axis) and unit output (X-axis). The heat input is from all fuels.

Same definition as HeatRateCurve
root oneOf EmissionCurve

EmissionCurve

Type: object

Relationship between the unit's emission rate in units of mass per hour (Y-axis) and output active power (X-axis) for a given type of emission. This curve applies when only one type of fuel is being burned.

Same definition as EmissionCurve
root oneOf VsCapabilityCurve

VsCapabilityCurve

Type: object

The P-Q capability curve for a voltage source converter, with P on X-axis and Qmin and Qmax on Y1-axis and Y2-axis.

Same definition as VsCapabilityCurve
root oneOf StartUpCostCurve

StartUpCostCurve

Type: object

Startup costs and time as a function of down time. Relationship between unit startup cost (Y1-axis) vs. unit elapsed down time (X-axis).

Same definition as StartUpCostCurve
root oneOf FuelCostCurve

FuelCostCurve

Type: object

Relationship between unit fuel cost in $/kWh(Y-axis) and unit output in MW (X-axis).

Same definition as FuelCostCurve
root oneOf RampRateCurve

RampRateCurve

Type: object

Ramp rate as a function of resource MW output.

Same definition as RampRateCurve
root oneOf StartUpTimeCurve

StartUpTimeCurve

Type: object

Startup time curve as a function of down time, where time is specified in minutes. Relationship between unit startup time (Y1-axis) vs. unit elapsed down time (X-axis).

Same definition as StartUpTimeCurve
